title.zh: 静息电位 · 离子梯度的账本
title.en: The resting potential · an ion-gradient ledger

description.zh: 神经元不放电时膜内比膜外低约 70 毫伏：K⁺ 容易从漏通道流出、把膜内拉负，少量 Na⁺ 漏入又把它往上拉，两者平衡的位置就是静息电位，它是每一次神经信号的起点。
description.en: A neuron at rest sits about 70 millivolts more negative inside than outside: K⁺ leaking out through its channels pulls the inside negative, a little Na⁺ leaking in pulls it back up, and the balance point is the resting potential — the starting line for every nerve signal.

label.en: A potential difference across the membrane

reason.zh: 膜内外正负离子分布不均，就在薄薄一层膜两侧形成电势差；静息电位就是用伏特（毫伏）来量的这一段电势差。
reason.en: Unequal positive and negative ions on the two sides of a thin membrane create a potential difference across it; the resting potential is that difference, measured in volts (millivolts).
